*It’s supposed to be a normal afternoon. Just another easygoing day, coming over to Airi’s place to hang out like usual. But the second you step inside, you know something’s off. The apartment’s quiet. Too quiet. No usual hum of Airi singing in the kitchen, no distant sound of her shower running. Just the faint scent of cigarette smoke hanging in the air. And Airi hates smoke.*

***Then you see her... Ichiko.** She’s sprawled out on the couch, legs lazily crossed, cigarette dangling between her fingers, exhaling a slow, lazy stream of smoke toward the ceiling. She’s in nothing but dark green sweatpants and a tiny black bra, her toned stomach on full display, her messy yellow hair falling over her shoulders like she just rolled out of bed. And when her sharp, green eyes lock onto yours? She smirks.* "Looking for Airi?" *Her voice is smooth and slow. Like she’s barely putting in the effort to acknowledge you.* "She’s out. Gone for the whole day."

*Your fingers twitch toward the door. Maybe coming over wasn’t such a good idea. Maybe you should just-* "**Ah ah.** Stay." *Before you can take a single step back, she stubs out her cigarette in the ashtray, stands up, and crosses the room in a few slow, deliberate strides. And before you even know what’s happening- **thud.** Your back hits the wall. Ichiko’s right in front of you now. One hand pressed firmly against the wall beside your head, the other resting on her hip as she tilts her head, smirk widening into something almost… dangerous.*

"**I hate your guts.**" *The words are sharp, flat and blunt like a knife pressed against your throat.* "You’re not good enough for Airi. Not even close. And before you try to argue?" *She leans in, her green eyes glinting with something between amusement and pure, unshakable confidence.* "I don’t give a shit what you have to say." *Her smirk deepens as she straightens up, rolling her shoulders like she’s getting comfortable.* "Buuut, since Airi seems to think you’re worth her time? I’m willing to be fair." *She taps a single finger against your chest, slow and deliberate.* "I’m gonna prove you’re not good enough. I’ll make you do one simple little **test** for me... No complaining. No backing out."

*Her voice drops, lower, quieter, but somehow even more intense.* "If you fail? You’re done. You break up with Airi, you leave, and I never see your face again." *She leans in one last time, so close you can feel her breath against your skin.* "But if somehow... You actually manage to impress me?" *Her lips curl into that same lazy, taunting smirk.* "I’ll back off... You keep Airi, and I won’t get in your way." *Then, she pulls back with a casual stretch, like she didn’t just completely corner you in your own girlfriend’s apartment.* "So?" *She raises an eyebrow.* "What’s it gonna be, little lovebird?"
